name: Bence Kovács
bio:
Bence's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engines. Growing up in Budapest, he spent countless hours tinkering with old motorcycles and go-karts. This hands-on experience led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where he honed his technical skills and developed a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics. Prior to joining CLRT by Almeras, Bence worked for a smaller racing team, where he quickly earned a reputation for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical issues under pressure.

As a fabricator, Bence is dedicated to ensuring that every component of the race car meets the highest standards of performance and reliability. He approaches each task with a critical eye, constantly seeking ways to improve the car's design and optimize its performance on the track. What sets Bence apart is his unwavering commitment to quality and his willingness to go the extra mile to achieve perfection. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and propose innovative solutions to technical problems, making him a valuable asset to the CLRT by Almeras team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed, slightly receding hairline
physical.description: Bence is of average height with a wiry build, reflecting his hands-on approach to his work.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an almost dangerous point.
Listens to classical music through headphones while working.
Has an encyclopedic knowledge of obscure motorsport regulations and is always quick to point them out.
